story: Bea said, “I want to give Grandpa Len a cup.” The cup's handle was wide because Grandpa Len's hand was stiff. The shaping rib slipped, and the cup was dented. Mr Ivo said, “The cup's wall is thick.” Grandpa Len said, “I can hold a bowl with two hands.” Bea said, “I want a thumb rest.” Bea used the sponge to shape the dent into a thumb rest. Mr Ivo fired the cup twice. The cup was cool. Bea gave Grandpa Len the cup. Grandpa Len poured tea into the cup. Grandpa Len's thumb rested in the thumb rest.
